thursdays.label: 13 August
thursdays.title: Art Night Thursday
thursdays.blurb: Twenty-eight galleries on view, ordered north to south, one long evening.

clusters.title: Bandra West
clusters.note: Start far north. Cab essential — no walking connection.

clusters.title: Prabhadevi
clusters.note: Solo stop. Cab from Bandra; cab onwards to Worli.

clusters.title: Worli
clusters.note: Solo stop on Dr Annie Besant Road. Cab between neighbours.

clusters.title: Kemps Corner → Khotachi Wadi
clusters.note: A long but possible 23-min walk between them through Girgaon — or quick cab.

clusters.title: Ballard Estate, Fort & Kala Ghoda
clusters.note: The main walking cluster. Ordered north to south, all within a ~1 km stretch.

clusters.title: Nariman Point
clusters.note: Single stop inside NCPA — bridge between Fort and Colaba clusters.

clusters.title: Colaba
clusters.note: Dense heart of the route. Most stops within 5-min walks.
